chain.prompt: A polished Thoughtloom desktop application screen, edge to edge at 1536 × 1024, crisp readable humanist sans text, no browser or device frame. This is the first moment of one evolving inquiry: search original input, read it with AI interpretations and connections, then discuss them. No folders, all-notes rail, note-list/editor layout, chat sidebar, or speech-bubble river. The compact horizontal header holds text-only Thoughtloom, Search notes with query ‘agents disagree’, and Capture. Below, a readable original-source band quotes ‘Maybe AI agents should be allowed to disagree before committing to a design.’ Label it ‘Original input · Unchanged’, with Open source. The inquiry trail reads ‘Search: agents disagree → Original thought’. The shared thinking surface is titled ‘Disagreement before a decision’. An inline ‘AI interpretation · Tentative’ attributes ‘Disagreement may expose assumptions before a decision.’ From that statement, fine labelled connections lead to three concise ideas: ‘Supports · Adversarial review’, ‘Tension · Reviewer overload’, ‘Depends on · Decision ownership’. These are explicitly ‘AI connection hypotheses’, with brief rationale and Inspect evidence affordances; no confidence scores. The main surface reads as a thought opening possibilities, not a grid of equal feature cards. A persistent ordinary text composer below asks ‘What would you like to explore about these ideas?’ Its principal action is ‘Discuss these together’. Keep the source band and composer as stable anchors for subsequent screens. Night #031315 frames a Parchment #FEF6E1 thinking surface; Lantern #EFB83F is the main action, muted Horizon #5E8BD6 selection only. Source Sans 3 throughout, including headings and quotes; flat solid surfaces, fine rules, no gradients, shadows, glow, serif, emblem, textile or fantasy. Footer: ‘Illustrative notes · AI hypotheses are not established facts’.

Edit this unapproved Thoughtloom desktop screen, preserving its content, original-source quote, central tentative interpretation, meaningful relationship branches, inspectable evidence, search and bottom composer. Establish a precise coherent flat brand grammar for the following two screens. The horizontal header and unchanged-original-source band use solid Night #031315 with Parchment #FEF6E1 lettering; the shared thinking surface is solid Parchment. Capture is a restrained secondary outline action; the bottom Discuss these together action alone uses a solid Lantern #EFB83F fill with Night text. Remove all gradients, paper texture, shadows, green, red and orange relationship colors. Use thin Night-neutral connector lines and explicit relationship labels; Horizon #5E8BD6 is reserved for the selected tentative interpretation and source links. Replace the three equal colored relationship cards with unboxed readable annotations at their branch ends, using fine rules and short attributed passages, not dashboard tiles. Preserve every hypothesis label, rationale, Inspect evidence link, source provenance label, inquiry trail and illustrative-content footer. Keep Source Sans 3-style humanist sans for headings, source quote and controls. No new logo, serif, sidebar, chat bubbles, devices or browser frame. The result remains a crisp 1536 × 1024 direct desktop screen. Do not invent notes, dates, scores or new actions.

brand.adaptation: Night/Parchment framing, purposeful Lantern/Horizon and Source Sans 3-inspired task type; no logo/emblem/artwork/font copied. Generated pixels approximate the reference.

limitations: Link and selection blues remain brighter than the pinned Horizon target; slight raster surface variation remains despite flat-color prompts.
